concurrency: New same-branch CI runs can automatically cancel older in-progress runs. Record cancellation as cancellation, not as a passing or failing test. Existing expensive experiment workflows use cancel-in-progress:false.

expected_pr_workflows.expensive_jobs: Existing scope outputs select native/full-repository lanes; required aggregate only permits explicitly inapplicable skips.

expected_pr_workflows.identity: Source head checkout is explicit. Base-merge lane verifies both prospective merge parents and exact merged tree against current PR base and head.

expected_pr_workflows.expensive_jobs: Existing change detector controls V8 builds; manual dispatch forces all variants and is unnecessary for normal PR verification.

final_verification: Fetch exact final PR head/base metadata after the ref update.
Fetch actions/runs filtered by exact final head SHA and identify the three expected workflow paths.
Inspect only those run job collections for scope, Codespell, blob policy, both architecture lanes, required aggregates and V8 metadata.
For a failing non-Rust source/docs check, read its exact job log before proposing a narrow repair; retain inherited broad failures and all failure evidence.
No manual dispatch, blanket retry, runner relabelling or broad local testing is required for this verification.

prevent_unnecessary_training.qualification: An evidence-only push leaves these trigger paths unchanged. Confirm against the actual previously pushed source-head to final-head changed paths; do not infer solely from the final commit parent.

raw_retention: The retrieved full workflow text remains local under audits/ci_trigger_source/. It is not required in the final publication delta; the original immutable source URLs, paths, content SHA256 and computed Git blob identities above identify the reviewed source.
scope: Read-only trigger and required-check review. Final head has not yet been pushed or checked by this reviewer. No workflows, gates, tests, source files or dispatch settings changed.
workflow_path_skipping: These three CI workflows have no workflow-level path filters. A push to the existing open PR source branch should produce pull_request synchronize runs; verify actual exact-head run metadata instead of assuming delivery.
